airport: An airport features expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings, large terminal buildings, and extensive aprons with parked aircraft, distinguishing it from the parallel linear tracks of railway stations, the dense factory structures of industrial zones, and the dense building clusters of commercial areas.
beach: A beach appears as a broad, smooth expanse of fine light tan sand with a gentle natural transition to water, distinguishing it from the sinuous dark water ribbon of rivers, the rugged rocky terrain of mountains, the enclosed still water of ponds, the dense building clusters of commercial areas, and the dock infrastructure of ports.
bridge: A bridge appears as a linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body with visible support pillars, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated roadway of viaducts, the dense building clusters of commercial areas, the enclosed still water of ponds, the flowing water of rivers, the factory structures of industrial zones, and the dock infrastructure of ports.
commercial: Commercial areas display dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings with flat rooftops, extensive paved parking lots between structures, and regular street grids, distinguishing them from the uniform gray grid of parking lots, the large factory buildings of industrial zones, the tightly packed rooftops of residential areas, the expansive runways of airports, the open green lawns of parks, the linear structures of bridges, and the smooth sand of beaches.
desert: A desert presents a vast, uniform expanse of light tan or pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures and no vegetation, distinguishing it from the regular geometric crop patterns of farmland and the rugged rocky terrain with elevation changes of mountains.
farmland: Farmland displays large, regularly gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns, alternating color bands of green and brown, and clear geometric field boundaries, distinguishing it from the vast uniform dry sand of desert, the uniform bright green grass of meadows, and the flat factory structures of industrial zones.
footballfield: A football field features a large, precisely rectangular bright green turf surface with clear white boundary lines, a central circle, and penalty areas, distinguishing it from the uniform unmarked green grass of meadows and the open green lawns with scattered trees of parks.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure, distinguishing it from the rugged rocky terrain of mountains, the sinuous dark water ribbon of rivers, the open green lawns with scattered trees of parks, and the enclosed still water of ponds.
industrial: Industrial areas display large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops, clusters of circular storage tanks, wide internal roads, and minimal vegetation, distinguishing them from the uniform gray grid of parking lots, the dense commercial buildings, the expansive runways of airports, the regular crop patterns of farmland, the parallel linear tracks of railway stations, the open green lawns of parks, the tightly packed rooftops of residential areas, the linear structures of bridges, and the dock infrastructure of ports.
meadow: A meadow presents a broad, uniform expanse of bright green grass with a smooth fine texture and no visible geometric patterns or markings, distinguishing it from the precisely rectangular marked turf of football fields, the regular crop row patterns of farmland, and the open green lawns with scattered trees and paths of parks.
mountain: Mountain terrain displays rugged, irregular topography with varied tones of rock and sparse vegetation, showing natural contour patterns and shadow variations from elevation changes, distinguishing it from the continuous dark green canopy of forests, the smooth light tan sand of beaches, and the vast uniform dry sand of deserts.
park: A park features large open green lawns with scattered trees, winding paths, and possibly small recreational facilities, distinguishing it from the enclosed still water of ponds, the dense continuous dark green canopy of forests, the dense building clusters of commercial areas, the tightly packed rooftops of residential areas, the sinuous dark water of rivers, the flat factory structures of industrial zones, and the precisely rectangular marked turf of football fields.
parking: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the dense building clusters of commercial areas, the dock infrastructure and moored ships of ports, the large factory buildings and storage tanks of industrial zones, and the long continuous elevated roadway of viaducts.
pond: A pond appears as a small, enclosed, roughly circular or irregular dark smooth water body surrounded by land with a clear defined shoreline, distinguishing it from the open green lawns of parks, the sinuous flowing ribbon of rivers, the linear elevated structures of bridges, the smooth light tan sand of beaches, the dock infrastructure of ports, and the dense continuous dark green canopy of forests.
port: A port contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the uniform gray grid of parking lots, the sinuous dark water of rivers, the enclosed still water of ponds, the linear elevated structures of bridges, the tightly packed rooftops of residential areas, the flat factory structures of industrial zones, and the smooth light tan sand of beaches.
railwaystation: A railway station features multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms, adjacent station buildings, and surrounding structures, distinguishing it from the expansive smooth runways and aprons of airports, the large factory buildings and storage tanks of industrial zones, and the long continuous elevated roadway of viaducts.
residential: Residential areas display a regular grid of streets with densely or moderately packed rectangular rooftops of houses and visible yards, distinguishing them from the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed buildings of commercial areas, the open green lawns with scattered trees of parks, the large factory buildings and storage tanks of industrial zones, and the dock infrastructure and moored ships of ports.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the enclosed still water of ponds, the dense continuous dark green canopy of forests, the smooth light tan sand of beaches, the open green lawns of parks, the dock infrastructure of ports, and the linear elevated structures of bridges.
viaduct: A viaduct appears as a long, elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars crossing over terrain or roads and casting rhythmic shadow patterns, distinguishing it from the linear water-crossing structure of bridges, the flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking lots, and the parallel linear railway tracks of railway stations.
